description: Aevex Corp. (not to be confused with AeroVironment AVAV) is a Solana Beach, California-based defense drone company specializing in airborne ISR (intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance) systems for the U.S. military, Special Operations Forces, and allied governments. The company offers a 'full drone stack' spanning unmanned aircraft, software, services, and in-theater manufacturing. Aevex IPO'd on the NYSE in April 2026 at $20/share, raising $312 million; shares doubled within two trading sessions. Madison Dearborn Partners retains 79% voting control post-IPO. Roughly 78% of 2025 revenue came from the U.S. government.
clarification: AVEX = Aevex Corp., a standalone defense ISR drone company. It is NOT an AeroVironment (AVAV) ADR, not Avant Communications, and not otherwise related to AVAV.
